subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime `sessions.patch` fail closed for legacy ownerless session rows?
rationale: The rule prevents unsafe cross-plugin adoption but intentionally removes a previously accepted persisted-session mutation path for rows created before ownership metadata existed.

options.title: Fail closed
options.body: Reject ownerless rows and reserve their management for operators or non-plugin clients.

options.title: Add migration
options.body: Provide an explicit safe owner-assignment migration before enforcing rejection.

recommendation.title: Fail closed
recommendation.body: Reject ownerless rows and reserve their management for operators or non-plugin clients.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current session ownership, patch projection, and transaction architecture in `48b0f4ed`.
